description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of a model across six different evaluation categories—“No Hallucination,” “Oriented,” “Active,” “Rigorous,” and “Correct”—with each category represented by a horizontal stacked bar divided into two segments: “Matched” (blue) and “Not Matched” (light blue), as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis represents percentage values from 0% to 100%, with tick marks at 20% intervals. For each category, the blue “Matched” portion occupies the majority of the bar, with its percentage value labeled inside the bar, while the light blue “Not Matched” portion is labeled to its right. Specifically, “No Hallucination” shows 98.33% Matched and 1.67% Not Matched; “Oriented” shows 97.33% Matched and 2.67% Not Matched; “Active” shows 97.00% Matched and 3.00% Not Matched; the unlabeled gray bar (likely a placeholder or omitted label) shows 94.00% Matched and 6.00% Not Matched; “Rigorous” shows 95.33% Matched and 4.67% Not Matched; and “Correct” shows 99.00% Matched and 1.00% Not Matched. The categories are listed vertically in descending order of “Matched” percentage, with “Correct” at the top and the unlabeled gray bar near the middle. The chart visually emphasizes high alignment (“Matched”) across all categories, with the lowest Matched percentage being 94.00% and the highest being 99.00%.
